findings.detail: Deterministic integration preview validates the exact six-file candidate, reports valid=true and would_write=6; no active-vault write was applied.
The evidence lock resolves 73 unique reviewed references through the hash-bound shared receipt; all 24 substantive section bindings reference locked evidence.
The 73 receipt records resolve source_id, source SHA-256, ingest unit path, unit content SHA-256, unit file SHA-256 and stable page locators against the assigned validated Markdown units.
All 28 UNCERTAIN candidates are excluded from the evidence lock: 17 SRC-0009 visual-fidelity cases and 11 SRC-0038 image-inspection cases. No future-vault binding relies on them.
The four knowledge updates and two question updates pass deterministic proposal validation; IDs, registered domains, paths and existing Obsidian links are valid.
Both questions have stable topics, one boolean intent, equivalent French and English wording, and null dependencies; no duplicate question ID or dependency cycle is introduced.

The release contains research, Commission guidance and voluntary/framework material only. SRC-0018 remains distinct from binding AI Act text; SRC-0036 and SRC-0038 remain bounded supervisory context; SRC-0039 remains voluntary. The notes must not be used alone to assert universal legal obligations.
This review establishes readiness only. Human approval must bind the exact candidate SHA-256 before deterministic integration.
